audit.ehviewerRecoveryUnavailable: The current metadata does not contain a valid E-Hentai/ExHentai URL, so a recovery preview cannot be generated.
audit.pageRecoveryDescription: Fetch only the selected missing pages, compare the local neighbors, then confirm before writing them back.
audit.pageRecoveryBatchSummary: {count} books selected; fetch only, review each book before writing back

audit.pageRecoveryBatchApply: Batch write back pending pages ({count} books)

audit.pageRecoverySourcePageUnavailable: Local page {localPage} maps to unavailable source page {sourcePage}. Adjust the offset or choose another source.
audit.pageRecoverySourceOffsetInvalid: Source offset must be an integer between -1000 and 1000.
audit.pageRecoverySourceChanged: The source or offset changed. Fetch the images again before confirming write-back.
audit.pageRecoveryComparisonHint: Local neighbors are shown on the sides; consecutive gaps show other fetched pages, with the current page in the center
audit.pageRecoveryConfirm: Write the selected images back to the original book?
audit.pageRecoveryConfirmUncertain: The online sequence cannot be matched automatically. You have checked the preview and confirmed these images correspond to the target pages. Write them back anyway?
audit.pageRecoveryPartialSuccess: Confirmed pages were written back, but trailing pages are still missing. Fetch and review them next.
audit.pageRecoveryMappingUncertain: The online page order cannot be mapped automatically; inspect the preview and confirm the write-back manually.
audit.pageRecoveryMappingAnchored: The source page count is anchored to the local numbering, so the gap mapping can follow the local filenames.
audit.pageRecoveryInferredLeading: Leading gap; fetched after online confirmation

audit.pageRecoveryLeadingSkipped: Boundary pages {pages} are not fully confirmed by the source page sequence; preview only, no direct write-back.
audit.pageRecoveryInferredTrailing: Trailing gap, confirmed by the source
audit.pageRecoveryAwaitingConfirmation: Pages fetched. Review them before writing back.
